messages.content: Implement the is_palindrome function in src/lib.rs so all tests pass. The function should ignore spaces, case, and punctuation.

content.text: I'll start by looking at the project structure and the failing tests.
Cargo is blocked in this sandbox. Let me check whether any Rust toolchain is usable:
Since the Rust toolchain can't execute here, let me verify the algorithm's behavior with an equivalent simulation:

input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && python3 -c "
def is_palindrome(s):
    # mirror of the Rust: keep alphanumerics, lowercase (Unicode-aware), compare to reverse
    chars = []
    for c in s:
        if c.isalnum():
            chars.extend(c.lower())
    return chars == chars[::-1]

cases = [
    ('racecar', True),
    ('A man a plan a canal Panama', True),
    ('hello', False),
    ('', True),                     # empty
    ('   ', True),                  # whitespace only
    ('!!!', True),                  # punctuation only
    ('Was it a car or a cat I saw?', True),
    ('No lemon, no melon', True),
    ('ab', False),
    ('a', True),
    ('aa', True),
    ('abba', True),
    ('abcba', True),
    ('abcab', False),
    ('A man, a plan, a canal, Panama!', True),
    ('12321', True),
    ('123421', False),
    ('École', False),
    ('été', True),                  # unicode accents
]
bad = [(s, e) for s, e in cases if is_palindrome(s) != e]
for s, e in cases:
    print(('ok  ' if is_palindrome(s) == e else 'FAIL'), repr(s), '->', is_palindrome(s), 'expected', e)
print()
print('mismatches:', bad)
"
cd "$(pwd)" && for p in /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /bin/sh; do echo "== $p"; $p -c 'print(1)' 2>&1 | head -2; done
for p in node deno bun perl ruby; do printf "%s: " "$p"; command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -e '1' 2>&1 | head -1 && echo "usable" || echo "not usable"; done 2>&1 | head -20
